text: SEMKIT-036: the default --threshold of a model (e5-small 0.97) is a same-intent similarity of two phrases. off-topic uses it as the similarity of a phrase to the centre of the core, where cosines are lower, so without --threshold most phrases get off_topic yes. Consider a separate default for off-topic in models.toml.
note: Taken into the thresholds task (per-step defaults in models.toml)
